items.title: Larry Ridley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 10, 2003
items.q: And I had my first road gig when I was sixteen, with Conte Candoli.

ctx.x: Well I was fortunate in that Freddie Hubbard and James Spaulding and a lot of us, we had our own little bands and we were playing jazz. In fact we had a hot little band. My uncle was friendly with some gentlemen who owned a club in Indianapolis. And we had a gig, we worked six nights a week with two matinees, and we were just teenagers. We were playing all the Art Blakey Jazz Messenger, Clifford Brown, Max Roach charts and everything. And we had a piano player by the name of Al Plank, a white guy who lives in San…
throughout the midwest in terms of our little group. And I had my first road gig when I was sixteen, with Conte Candoli.
